title.native: いちばんうしろの大魔王

description:
After enrolling at the Constant Magic Academy, Akuto Sai discovers he's not just a gifted student with magical powers; he's destined to become the Demon King. And though he's not that crazy about the idea, it drives the girls wild! From the sexy school girls in his class to the skin-obsessed android who's programmed to seduce him, Akuto has no shortage of wacky girl trouble. How much temptation can a demon king take?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

node.description: A weird girl who seems to have some kind of relationship with Akuto, who she calls Aa-chan. She is astonishingly optimistic. Her special abilities are disappearing, flying and eating amazing amounts of rice, to the point that, when she has to grow a plant using her mana, the plant takes the form of a rice plant. Her hair has two sprouts on the top that wag depending on how she feels.

Akuto Sai was left on the door steps of a church by a strange woman. He grows up and transfers into the Constant Academy for Magical Arts, wanting to be a high priest. He meets Junko Hattori on the train to the school, and forms a pact with her to make the world a better place. The predicting spirit Yata Garasu predicts that he will be a Demon Lord upon graduation. Yata's predictions have never been wrong, and everyone becomes afraid of him as a result. Even so, he still tries to do the right thing when situations happen around him and he is shown to have an incredible amount of power within him, shown when he absorbs a demon dog's mana to revert it back to normal, something which a normal mage is unable to do. He struggles from time to time when his power comes forth and attempts to use the destructive energies to help instead of harm. Sai aims to become part of his country's highest order of magicians and contribute to society.     ~!Later, he learns to manage his evil powers, so he can use them on his own will. He normally uses them when he gets angry.     When he reminisce his past better, he remembers that, when he was a child, he wanted to destroy the "Gods" -that actually are Giant Computer Systems-.    When he was attacked by Junko, he carries her and tells her that after it was all over, he would take good care of her.!~

Korone is a Liladan (リラダン Riradan?), a race of androids, sent by the government to observe Akuto 24/7. She is usually emotionless and stolid, but occasionally curious when it comes to certain things. However, she does display human characteristics on occasion; particularly, she enjoys teasing Akuto, often doing ecchi things in front of him. She sleeps in a small storage closet in Akuto's dorm and has numerous firearms and other items stored inside her handbag, a sort of hammerspace. Korone has the ability to read other people's emotions and can detect an individual's mana levels. She, like all Liladans, can be temporarily deactivated by pulling a switch resembling a rabbit's tail located on her lower back. She starts having feelings for Sai.

Junko is introduced in episode one of the anime. She's very skilled with a short blade and wooden sword, both of which she carries or summons. She also has a tsundere nature, often becoming embarrassed and misunderstanding situations because of that. She comes from a Suharaist family that protects the Empire and is very strict about upholding the values that were taught to her.   ~!She wants to marry Sai Akuto and even temporarily removed herself from her family to aid Sai when he was in trouble, trying to destroy the Gods and save Keena. As Sai was about to leave on  Peterhausen, he told her that when he gets back he will take good care of her.!~

Fujiko Etou is the current head of the Etou family, the head of the girl's dorms at Constant Academy, and the only person who understands Akuto's current situation. Her older brother, the Etou's previous head, was killed after failing a mission, causing Fujiko to become the new head of the family, though for unexplained reasons, she kept her brother's (revived) head, which is kept in a jar-like container filled with fluid. She is the leader of an underground movement that uses black magick (magic) for evil purposes and plans to use Akuto's demon powers once he becomes Demon Lord for her own purposes.

A boy who thinks Akuto Sai is amazing and always bugs him by pretending to be brothers and calling Sai "Demon King". He often states that he is Sai's most loyal follower.     ~! soon it shows that he is the reincanation of a Hero, who later recovers his powers, becoming a monster-slayer superhero called Brave. !~

School's physician and instructor. She constantly reminds Akuto that if he dies she wants to turn him undead so she can analyze him, she even goes to the extent where she tells him if he wishes to die to just go to her.

Student council president. She is a little bit secretive in the undergrounds of the school. Judging by her expressions it seems like she knows a little more then she lets on.She develops a crush on Akuto. She doesn't want Akuto to be the demon lord.   ~! She is the first girl to kiss Akuto. In episode 5 in the anime she gave him a reward kiss for winning ''her game''.!~

She just transfered to the school but seems to know what Etou Fujiko is up to. She also states that she was just going to tease Sai Akuto a little but now that she knows he is cute he will be seeing a lot more of her. She also stated that once she gets attached to something she can't leave it alone.
Member of the Student Council. She uses magic to tame bats and fight with them.
Member of the Students Council. She uses magic to transform into a giant wolf and uses that to fight.
Fujiko's older brother.   He discovered Peterhausen's den. When Yamato Bouichirou learned about that, he killed him, but, before that, Etou's brother erased his own memories.

Member of the Student Council. She has made a mecha, that he uses to fight. It seems that the only word she knows is "guga".   ~! In the last episode during the credits she actually speaks saying "thats our Prez" !~
A dragon left behind by the last demon lord who is now serving Akuto. Keena is the first person to approach Peterhausen without being afraid, she is even seen sleeping on him.
Junko Hattori's sister. She is also known as the idol Yuri Hoshino.

He is the main antagonist of the series. He fought alongside the school Principle to defeat the previous Demon King. He uses a technique called "Hudgson", that allows him to slice the opponent´s body with any sword so fast that the enemy cannot see the moment when he attacks.      ~!He wants to use Soga Keena´s body to dominate Gods.!~
